# Documentation Structure & Style Conventions

## Summary

Standardized Markdown output directory tree (16 directories), GitHub-style callout admonitions for intentionally-unused parameters, inferred items, warnings, and side effects. LaTeX structure guidance (article vs book). Four style rules: no invented identifiers, explicit inference marking, glossary symbol completeness, Mermaid/TikZ for diagrams.
